game_concept: A tower defense set in Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point, the lighthouse on the point: the sailor must hold off rogue crabs while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Else Escape: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of rogue crabs, dodge the other.
theme: Coastal Port – Lighthouse Point: the lighthouse on the point
core_gameplay_loop: In Lighthouse Point, repeat each round: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of rogue crabs, dodge the other. Then check hero_hp and advance.
player_objective: Protect the lighthouse lamp from rogue crabs in Lighthouse Point: keep hero_hp above zero until the 33-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 2 (intro tier): Else Escape
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 3, Level 2, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
